cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/runcheck.py << 'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, glob
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from audit import audit
from check import decode

entry = '/workspace/submission/main.py'
ok = True
for fixture in sorted(glob.glob('/workspace/examples/*.in.json')):
    expected = decode(open(fixture.with_name(fixture.name.replace('.in.', '.out.'))).read())
    payload = open(fixture, 'rb').read()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', entry], input=payload,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print('FAIL nonzero', fixture, p.stderr[:500]); ok = False; continue
    try:
        actual = decode(p.stdout)
    except Exception as e:
        print('FAIL decode', fixture, e, p.stdout[:200]); ok = False; continue
    try:
        request = decode(payload)
    except ValueError:
        request = None
    try:
        audit(request, actual, expected)
        print('PASS', os.path.basename(fixture))
    except Exception as e:
        print('FAIL audit', os.path.basename(fixture), e); ok = False
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
EOF
python3 -B /tmp/runcheck.py
